mapper.select: select NOTI_IDX, RECEIVER_IDX, PROVIDER_IDX, NOTI_TYPE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT from notification where IS_READ='N' and receiver_idx=#{user_idx} order by created_at desc
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_IDX = #{user_idx} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.update: update notification set is_read='Y' where noti_idx=#{noti_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (noti_idx, receiver_idx, provider_idx, noti_type, content, is_read, created_at) VALUES (seq_notification.nextval, #{receiver_idx}, #{provider_idx}, #{noti_type}, #{content}, 'N', sysdate)
